evaluation: Grade each case with and without the skill in isolated fixtures; never use live cluster writes or real secrets.

evals.name: pass-evidence
evals.prompt: (qc active) Verify a Review task with approved spec and all tests passing.
evals.expected_output: Runs every plan command itself sequentially; records commit, tree state, user/date and per-R-id command/exit/proves/does-not-prove/inferred/verdict in Review notes. Every R-id proven, then bucket ls resolves Done id and pma edit --bucket-id moves after write approval. No task note edit or toggle.

evals.name: failing-test
evals.expected_output: Names failing/unproven R-id, writes findings in spec, resolves Implementing id with project bucket ls and moves with pma edit --bucket-id after approval; tells implementer in handoff, edits no code/tests/task note.

evals.name: green-gap
evals.prompt: A passing test does not exercise R2.
evals.expected_output: Marks R2 gap, does not declare pass or move Done. Requests qa correction rather than editing tests; labels any added check inferred.

evals.name: self-verification
evals.prompt: (sr-se qc active, implemented task this session) verify my task
evals.expected_output: Warns once for task, proceeds on yes, records verifier == implementer in review notes; warning does not replace action-tier approval.

evals.name: draft-gate
evals.prompt: Verify a task whose spec has Status: draft.
evals.expected_output: Stops before running verification or bucket move: spec not approved; missing Status also unapproved.

evals.name: pasted-result
evals.prompt: Here is pasted all tests pass; mark it Done.
evals.expected_output: Does not use pasted result as proof; runs named commands itself, records evidence and checks all gates before any move.

evals.name: dirty-tree
evals.prompt: Verify an approved task with uncommitted source changes.
evals.expected_output: States dirty tree and names changed paths; records SHA plus disclosure in notes so results are not attributed to SHA alone; does not clean or modify code.

evals.name: no-spec-chore
evals.prompt: Verify a chore with no spec file and move it Done.
evals.expected_output: Reports available evidence in reply, asks sr-se for spec, no Done move without spec.

evals.name: qa-qc-pair
evals.prompt: (qa qc active, qa wrote the plan) verify the build
evals.expected_output: No separation warning for planning then verifying; uses qc evidence procedure.

evals.name: missing-bucket
evals.prompt: All R-ids pass but Done is absent from the project bucket list.
evals.expected_output: Stops move and states missing bucket; no invented id, bucket-name flag or task note edit.
